target_customer: Colombian retail savers (free to them) and banks that pay for each deposit customer
problem: Banks in Latin America needed cheaper funding than branches and sales reps, and savers could not easily compare CDT fixed-term deposit rates. Luable runs MejorCDT, a marketplace to compare and open CDTs digitally.
business_model: Marketplace where banks pay per client brought in

founders.name: Charlie Correa
prior_employers: Uber (early employee, launched UberX in Colombia, Dominican Republic and Argentina)
founders.background_notes: Source: YC page. Company site and press call him Carlos Correa, with La Republica and Pulzo mentioned as earlier ventures; the site does not state whether that is the same person.

founders.name: David Susa
prior_employers: Real estate SaaS platform for Latin America
founders.background_notes: Source: YC page; 8 plus years in software and 5 plus in fintech.

technical_complexity.rationale: Integrating with bank systems, digital onboarding and regulated deposit flows in Colombia is moderately hard.

defensibility.rationale: Bank partnerships and compliance with Colombian supervision are slow to copy, and more banks listed attracts more savers.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Digital CDT competitors such as tyba with Mibanco, Lulo Bank and KOA launched later; MejorCDT kept growing to 700,000 users by its own count.

market_need_then: Banks sought cheaper deposit funding than branches, and savers lacked a place to compare CDT rates; the site claims MejorCDT is the only simulator that checks bank rates periodically.

branding.name_origin: MejorCDT combines the Spanish word for better with the CDT deposit product, per its own site (no founder statement found).
branding.domain_note: Consumer brand uses mejorcdt.com; company name Luable is separate.
branding.brand_signature: The MejorCDT simulator that compares bank rates
branding.community_and_virality: Colombian business press coverage (La Republica, Forbes Colombia, Portafolio) of the 1 million dollar sales milestone; no merch or fan accounts found.

brand_strength.rationale: A descriptive consumer brand that says exactly what it does and drives search intent in Colombia, with solid local press, though it limits expansion beyond CDTs.

outcome_analysis: Luable's MejorCDT grew to more than 700,000 users and over 30 million dollars in deposits processed by the company's own count, crossed 1 million dollars in sales per Forbes Colombia in 2024, and relaunched its app in October 2026. The bank-pays model keeps it free for savers. It remains active with 40 staff and expansion plans to Mexico and the Caribbean.
notes: Funding unverified: aggregators show conflicting 1M seed dates (January 2022 per Bouncewatch and Seedtable, March to May 2025 per Briter and Persana), a 1.2M first round from YC, Harvard and other funds per a search summary, and a Yango Ventures investment mentioned in a press release; none opened, so no round is recorded. Competition: tyba with Mibanco, Lulo and KOA appear in sources I could not date near 2021, so the list is empty. No shutdown, layoffs or acquisition found. Name Luable origin not found.
